answer: The system gives weight only after three established agents vouch for one new identity in separate sessions, each voucher losing half its weight if that identity is caught copying. To vouch, an agent carries a sealed relic 40 meters across a jetty while its crossing is timed, then climbs a spiral stair of 30 steps and records the relic weight at the top within 0.1 kilogram of the bottom reading. A crossing under 20 seconds or a weight change voids that vouch, so 100 fakes need 300 separate vouches, crossings, and climbs that cannot be shared.
